identitySignals: Agenda names the funder as 'Annie's and General Mills' in Berkeley, CA; Annie's Homegrown is headquartered in Berkeley and is a brand of General Mills (Annie's own site shows a General Mills copyright and routes contact to General Mills)
General Mills' website lists Annie's among its brands

OUSD school wellness materials list Annie's / General Mills among funders of OUSD wellness work, matching the grant for student health programs (found via search snippet; OUSD page itself could not be fetched)
research.notes: The agenda names two parties as one grantor: Annie's (a General Mills brand, Berkeley) and General Mills (parent, Minneapolis). The grant may come from a corporate giving program rather than either legal entity; the exact legal grantor was not confirmed. Annie's founding-location claim and the OUSD funder link rest on search snippets and an unfetched page. No contact details or registry IDs filled because only a consumer phone line and web form were found. Not suitable to publish without human review.

profile.summary: General Mills is a food company that makes packaged foods for people and pets. Its brands include Annie's, an organic food brand that was based in Berkeley, California.
